info.name: DaaS IQ Host pool session host deployments API

items.docs:
Adds session hosts to an existing host pool. The new hosts are built from the VM settings already saved
on that pool, so those settings must be in place before this call and are not accepted in the request body.
            
For pools with a DynamicHosts scaling profile, scale-in cleanup treats all stopped
zero-session hosts above MinHosts as elastic capacity, including manually added hosts.
